recommended_action: Design experiment testing a structurally non-linear third recipe (DOM hierarchy depth, conditional inclusion based on element parent-child relationships, or semantic role weighting) that could produce rankings outside the canonical-weighted range. The key requirement is that the recipe must not be a linear combination of canonical and weighted densities — it must use structural information (DOM tree position, element nesting, semantic roles) to produce density values that are not bounded between canonical and weighted. Alternatively, if the non-linear path is blocked, design an experiment that quantifies the MIXED outcome resolution lever: for each task-definition pair, measure whether definition choice or task type is the primary determinant of recipe sensitivity, and test whether restricting density metric use to recipe-insensitive pairs (those where definition choice has minimal effect) provides sufficient coverage.
